Program objective: Is the purpose limited to testing EM on three vessels, or is the contractor expected to design the future operational Hawai'i shortline EM program, including system standards, coverage, review, staffing, costs, and scaling? A: The purpose of the effort includes both pilot EM deployments and support for planning a potential future operational EM program. The Contractor shall procure, install, and evaluate EM systems on three pilot vessels and three trips, assess camera configurations and operational impacts, evaluate data retrieval and transfer procedures, conduct data review and QA/QC, and refine VMPs and review methodologies based on pilot findings. This is designed to inform PWS Section 6.5 that specifically requires the Contractor to support NMFS planning associated with future implementation of an operational EM program. This
